name: ilang-wechat-awesome
description: WeChat official account writing assistant. Feeds on your source material, restructures it with writing genes distilled from 200+ field-tested articles, runs a 12-point self-check with built-in de-AI editing, outputs publish-ready Markdown plus titles and a cover image prompt. Chinese-first. By iLang.

displayDescription.en: Feed it your source material and it restructures the piece with writing genes distilled from 200+ field-tested WeChat articles, runs a 12-point self-check with built-in de-AI editing, then outputs publish-ready Markdown, three titles and a cover image prompt while following WeChat content rules. By iLang.
displayDescription.zh: 投喂素材出公众号文章：爆文结构重组，12项自查，内置去AI味和合规红线，出正文、标题和封面提示词。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有素材，帮我按爆文结构写成公众号文章
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have source material, turn it into a WeChat article

quickPrompts.en: I have source material, turn it into a WeChat article
quickPrompts.zh: 我有素材，帮我按爆文结构写成公众号文章

quickPrompts.en: Give me 3 titles and a cover image prompt for this article
quickPrompts.zh: 帮这篇公众号文章出3个标题和封面图提示词

quickPrompts.en: Remove the AI flavor from this draft and check WeChat compliance
quickPrompts.zh: 把这篇初稿去AI味，顺便查公众号合规
